tools.name: add-favorite-driver
tools.description: Saves a 3-letter driver code to the user's favorites (used for auto-selection when the driver is available).

tools.name: annotation-clear
tools.description: Clears all annotations on registered charts (same as Clear All on the toolbar).

tools.name: annotation-redo
tools.description: Redoes the last undone annotation action on all registered charts.

tools.name: annotation-undo
tools.description: Undoes the last annotation action on all registered charts.

tools.name: clear-favorites
tools.description: Removes all saved favorite driver codes.

tools.name: clear-selected-laps
tools.description: Removes all laps from the Selected Laps control (clears loaded telemetry compare set).

tools.name: compare-telemetry
tools.description: Distance-aligns lap B onto lap A and returns decimated samples with delta = A − B for a channel (default speed). Both laps must be loaded via select-lap. For cumulative lap-time gap vs Distance (the Time Delta chart), use get-time-delta — do not pass channel "time".

channel.description: Channel to compare (default "speed"). Not "time" — use get-time-delta.

tools.name: get-corners
tools.description: Returns corners.json for the current session (number, distance m, x/y, angle) plus track rotation. Loaded automatically when the first telemetry lap is selected.

tools.name: get-current-selection
tools.description: Returns the homepage's current state as JSON: selected year, event, session, drivers, active tab (chart/data/docs), view mode (essential/expert), all chart/telemetry toggles, chart visibility picks, annotation mode, and saved favorite drivers.

tools.name: get-data-status
tools.description: Returns whether lap times have finished loading for the currently selected drivers: status idle|no-drivers|loading|partial|ready, plus loaded/missing driver lists.

tools.name: get-data-table
tools.description: Returns the Data-tab style lap table as structured JSON rows (not a file download). Includes compound/stint/life/pos/sectors and clean/outlier flags. Prefer this over trigger-csv-export for agents.

hideOutliers.description: Override outliers toggle (flags only; all rows still returned).

tools.name: get-fastest-laps
tools.description: From loaded lap-times data, returns each selected driver's fastest clean (non pit-in/out, non-outlier) lap with sector times, plus ranking and head-to-head gap. Optional quali segment filter (Q1/Q2/Q3). Use before select-lap / get-time-delta.

segment.description: Optional qualifying segment filter, e.g. "Q3". Omit for whole session.

tools.name: get-lap-times
tools.description: Returns per-lap timing for selected drivers from the loaded homepage dataset (respects Fuel Correction and Hide Outliers toggles unless overridden). Default cleanOnly=true excludes pit-in/out, deleted, and 107% outlier laps.

cleanOnly.description: If true (default), only clean racing laps. If false, all laps with isClean/isOutlier flags.

tools.name: get-positions
tools.description: Returns lap-by-lap race position series for selected drivers from loaded lap data.

tools.name: get-race-pace-comparison
tools.description: Head-to-head clean-lap pace comparison (shared-lap deltas, stint H2H, rolling pace). delta = driverA − driverB (negative = driverA faster). Defaults to the first two selected drivers.

drivers.description: Two-or-more driver codes (default: current selection; first two used as A/B).

tools.name: get-stint-summary
tools.description: Returns per-stint pace stats (compound, lap range, best/mean/median, crude deg) for selected drivers from loaded lap data. Uses the same clean-lap / fuel / outlier rules as get-lap-times.

tools.name: get-telemetry-channel
tools.description: Returns distance/time-aligned samples for one channel on a loaded lap (decimated; default maxPoints=150, max 500). Channels: speed, throttle, brake, drs, rpm, gear, acc_x/y/z, x/y/z, DistanceToDriverAhead, etc. Prefer get-telemetry-stats for aggregates.

lap.description: dataKey or 'ANT-58' / driver+lap via separate fields.

driver.description: 3-letter code if not using full dataKey.

lapNumber.description: Lap number if not using full dataKey.

tools.name: get-telemetry-stats
tools.description: Aggregate stats for loaded telemetry laps: top/avg/min speed, throttle/brake/DRS duty, gear shifts, peak accelerations, lap distance. Does not return full sample arrays.

laps.description: dataKeys or DRV-lap refs (default: all loaded / selected).

tools.name: get-telemetry-status
tools.description: Returns whether selected telemetry laps are present in state.telData: idle|no-laps|loading|partial|ready.

laps.description: Optional dataKeys or 'DRV-lap' pairs; defaults to selectedLaps.

tools.name: get-telemetry-summary
tools.description: Returns which telemetry laps are loaded in state.telData (dataKeys, drivers, laps, channel lists, point counts). Call select-lap first. For channel units see list-telemetry-channels.

tools.name: get-time-delta
tools.description: Returns the same Distance-vs-gap series as the telemetry Time Delta chart. reference = first lap (lapA), compare = second (lapB). delta = compare − reference in seconds (positive = compare behind/slower). mode auto uses sector-anchored math when Align is on and sector times exist (same as the UI); otherwise classic length-scaled interpolation. Prefer this over compare-telemetry channel=time.

lapA.description: Reference lap dataKey or DRV-lap (default: first selected/loaded).

lapB.description: Compare lap dataKey or DRV-lap (default: second selected/loaded).

mode.description: auto (default) follows Align toggle; "classic" / "sector" force an algorithm.

tools.name: list-available-options
tools.description: Returns the current year/event/session/driver dropdown options as JSON (including driver full names/teams when the session drivers.json has loaded). Use this before select-race-data to discover valid values.

tools.name: list-stint-chips
tools.description: Returns the current stint analysis chips (driver, stint number, visible, pinned) from the Expert stint driver form. Empty if Expert mode is off or stint data has not rendered.

tools.name: list-telemetry-channels
tools.description: Returns the TracingInsights telemetry channel catalog (ids, aliases, units, descriptions) from DATA_REFERENCE.md / Q.py tel.json fields: speed, throttle, brake, drs, rpm, gear, distance, rel_distance, acc_x/y/z, x/y/z, DriverAhead, DistanceToDriverAhead, time.

tools.name: remove-selected-lap
tools.description: Removes one lap from Selected Laps (e.g. driver VER lap 10).

tools.name: reset-chart-visibility
tools.description: Restores the default Chart settings picks so every lap-time and telemetry chart is visible again.

tools.name: reset-telemetry-layout
tools.description: Restores the default telemetry chart order (same as the Reset layout button next to Edit layout in Expert mode).

tools.name: select-f1-data
tools.description: Fill in F1 data selections (year, event, session, drivers) plus chart/telemetry toggles and submit; the dashboard applies them.

tools.name: select-lap
tools.description: Loads and selects a specific lap's telemetry for the current session (e.g. VER lap 12). Year, event and session must already be selected; the lap appears in the selected-laps control once loaded.

tools.name: select-race-data
tools.description: Sets the year, event, session and/or drivers on the F1 telemetry homepage in one call. Each provided value is applied in order (year → event → session → drivers), waiting for the UI to load each downstream list. Omit a field to leave it unchanged.

event.description: Event / Grand Prix name as shown in the dropdown, e.g. "British Grand Prix".

tools.name: set-annotation-color
tools.description: Sets the global annotation stroke/fill color (hex, e.g. #00ff00).

tools.name: set-annotation-mode
tools.description: Switches the chart annotation toolbar on or off (expert mode).

enabled.description: true to enable annotation mode, false to disable.

tools.name: set-annotation-tool
tools.description: Selects the active annotation toolbar tool (Expert annotation mode): select, pencil, text, arrow, line, rect, ellipse, eraser.

tools.name: set-chart-option
tools.description: Enables or disables a homepage toggle. Lap chart: outliers, smoothing, fuel, trackStatus, autoFastest, sessionTime. Race/stint: raceTraceShadow, stintLowess. Telemetry: markers, corners, decimation, align, editLayout. Expert: annotation. enabled must be a real boolean.

enabled.description: true to enable, false to disable.

tools.name: set-chart-visibility
tools.description: Shows or hides a lap-time or telemetry chart (same as the Expert Chart settings modal). Lap charts: lapchart, heatmap, stint, sector, tyre, position, race-trace. Telemetry: speed, delta, throttle, brake, driver-action, gear, rpm, drs, driver-ahead, distance-ahead, gap-ahead, acc-x, acc-y, acc-z, elevation.

chart.description: Which chart to show or hide.

visible.description: true to show, false to hide.

tools.name: set-data-table-column
tools.description: Shows or hides a Data-tab column group (same as the table column toggles). Columns: compounds, stints, tyre-life, track-status, positions, personal-best, pitstops, sector-times. Open the Data tab first so the table is rendered.

enabled.description: true to show, false to hide.

tools.name: set-drivers
tools.description: Selects which drivers to compare for the current session, by 3-letter code (e.g. VER, HAM). Waits for the driver list to load if needed.

tools.name: set-event
tools.description: Selects an event / Grand Prix for the currently selected year. Resets session and drivers.

event.description: Event name as shown in the dropdown, e.g. "British Grand Prix".

tools.name: set-quali-segment
tools.description: Filters lap/stint/tyre charts to a qualifying segment (Q1/Q2/Q3/SQ1/…). Pass "All" or "" to clear. Only available for qualifying-style sessions after data loads.

tools.name: set-sector-visibility
tools.description: Shows or hides a sector series on the Expert sector chart (S1/S2/S3 chips). Requires Expert mode and loaded lap data so the sector controls exist.

enabled.description: true to show the sector, false to hide it.

tools.name: set-session
tools.description: Selects a session (e.g. Race, Qualifying) for the currently selected event. Resets drivers. Waits for the driver list to refresh for the new session.

tools.name: set-stint-lowess-frac
tools.description: Sets the stint chart LOWESS smoothing fraction (0.05–1.0), same as the Smoothing slider next to Tyre Performance.

tools.name: set-stint-pin
tools.description: Pins/unpins a stint on the Expert stint chart (📌 buttons). Pass driver + stint + pinned, or clearAll:true to unpin every stint.

pinned.description: true to pin, false to unpin.

clearAll.description: If true, clicks Unpin all (ignores other args).

tools.name: set-stint-visibility
tools.description: Toggles a stint checkbox in the Expert stint analysis form (same as the per-stint chips). Pass driver + stint + enabled, or driver + mode "all"|"none" for Select all / Hide all.

stint.description: Stint number (1-based), required unless mode is set.

enabled.description: true to show the stint, false to hide (ignored when mode is set).

mode.description: Bulk action: "all" = Select all, "none" = Hide all for that driver.

tools.name: set-telemetry-layout
tools.description: Reorders telemetry charts (same as Edit layout drag/up-down). Pass an ordered list of chart ids; omitted ids are appended in the default order. Ids: speedchart, deltachart-section, throttlechart, brakechart, driveractionchart, gearchart, rpchart, drschart, driveraheadchart, distancetodriveraheadchart, gaptodriveraheadchart, acc_xchart, acc_ychart, acc_zchart, elevationchart.

order.description: Desired chart id order (partial lists are completed with defaults).

tools.name: set-view-mode
tools.description: Switches between the Essential (core charts) and Expert (advanced charts) view modes.

tools.name: set-year
tools.description: Selects a season year on the homepage. Resets event, session and drivers (they must be re-selected afterwards).

tools.name: switch-tab
tools.description: Switches the main view between the Chart, Data (lap times table) and Docs (FIA documents) tabs.

tools.name: trigger-chart-screenshot
tools.description: Triggers a PNG download of a chart — the same action as clicking its Download button. Charts: lapchart, heatmap, stint, sector, tyre-strategy, position-changes, race-trace, weather, track-map, speed, delta, throttle, brake, gear, rpm, drs, elevation.

tools.name: trigger-csv-export
tools.description: Triggers a CSV download of the lap-times data table. The Data tab must be populated first (session + drivers selected).

tools.name: wait-for-data
tools.description: Polls until lap times are loaded for all currently selected drivers (or until timeout). Returns the final get-data-status payload. Call after select-race-data / set-drivers before reading lap tools.

drivers.description: Optional subset of driver codes to wait for (defaults to current selection).

tools.name: wait-for-telemetry
tools.description: Polls until the requested (or currently selected) telemetry laps are in state.telData. Use after select-lap / auto-fastest.

laps.description: dataKeys or 'ANT-58' style refs (defaults to selectedLaps).
